svg.aria-label: S11 Rename, the map table, the free lists and what finishes here
svg.text: S11 Rename, the map table, the free lists and what finishes here

The map table row by row, the queue entry written for every rename, three free lists with their counts, and the move, zero and immediate paths that end at rename. The player writes the physical register.
the old mapping, kept until retire
one per file, a register returns at retire
Each architectural name has one row.
The player writes the mapping into the empty cells.
~ When the queue is full, rename stalls.
~ A flush walks it back from the tail.
sources are read in the map
a destination comes from a free list
the eight are compared with themselves
physical registers in place of names
A register pops at rename and pushes back at retire.
a move maps its destination to the source
a zeroed destination maps to the zero register
the rest take an integer unit
Each writes the map table and takes no queue entry.
The player lights the path a micro-op took.
The arrows write the map table.
Firestorm splits the active list into retire groups and this queue.
KB: rename.width, int_prf.total, int_prf.headroom, fp_prf.total, fp_prf.headroom, flags_prf.total, flags_prf.headroom, int_prf.imm_regs, rename.mov_imm_limit, retire.rename_queue
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
